solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: A river running down to one American state and another

indicators.note: in a down clue the pieces run downwards, one leading on to the next

parts.note: R is the standard abbreviation for river on maps
Kansas, a state in the US Midwest

explanation.surface: A river flows south from one US state into a neighbouring one.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is the last word: 'another' means a second American state, following on from the one named in the wordplay.
explanation.definitionFit: Arkansas is a different member of the fifty US states from the one in the wordplay, hence a second such state.

clue.text: Record previous evidence of road-user's inexperience?

parts.note: an LP is a long-playing record
late can mean former or previous, as in 'the late chairman'

explanation.surface: Someone digs out past proof that a driver was a novice.
explanation.walkthrough: In Britain a learner driver must display an L-plate, a red L on a white square, until passing the test.
explanation.definitionFit: The plate shows other motorists that the driver is still a learner, hence inexperienced; the question mark flags the definition by example.

clue.text: Anvil maybe, blacksmith's first one

indicators.note: first picks the opening letter of the word blacksmith's

parts.note: taken as the word itself

explanation.surface: An anvil is what a blacksmith reaches for first.
explanation.walkthrough: The anvil here is not the smith's block but the tiny ear bone also called the incus.
explanation.definitionFit: The anvil, or incus, is one of the three small ossicles of the middle ear, an example of the skeleton's parts.

clue.text: Heading north, salesperson encountered anger

indicators.note: in a down clue, going north means the letters read upwards, back to front

parts.note: rep, short for sales representative
met is the past tense of meet, to encounter

explanation.surface: A travelling salesman heading north runs into an angry reception.
explanation.definitionFit: Temper in the sense of a fit of rage is a synonym for anger, as in 'lose your temper'.

clue.text: Miser has to get a foreign article for nothing — what he must do?

indicators.note: the miser's name is made to receive something new
for marks the new letters standing in place of the old one

parts.note: Scrooge, the tight-fisted hero of Dickens's A Christmas Carol
O looks like the figure zero, nothing
un is the French for a, an indefinite article

explanation.surface: A miser must obtain foreign goods without paying, which is just his style.
explanation.walkthrough: One O in SCROOGE is swapped for UN. The definition 'what he must do' points back to the miser: getting things for nothing is his way.
explanation.definitionFit: To scrounge is to cadge things free of charge, exactly the habit expected of a skinflint.

clue.text: Bow to convey greeting — backside becomes visible!

indicators.note: the bowing word carries the greeting inside it

parts.note: to bow is to bend at the waist
hi is an informal hello

explanation.surface: Someone bows in greeting and accidentally exposes their bottom.
explanation.walkthrough: 'becomes visible' just completes the joke of the surface.
explanation.definitionFit: Behind is a colloquial word for the buttocks, the same as a person's rear.

clue.text: Nimble agent nabbing traitor finally

indicators.note: the agent word catches the next letter inside it

parts.note: a spy is a secret agent

indicators.note: finally takes the closing letter of the word traitor

explanation.surface: A quick-footed secret agent arrests a turncoat.
explanation.definitionFit: Spry describes someone lively and agile, a synonym for nimble.

clue.text: Admonish soldiers wanting to demonstrate

parts.note: RE, the Royal Engineers of the British Army
to prove is to demonstrate or show

explanation.surface: A rebuke for troops keen to stage a protest.
explanation.definitionFit: To reprove is to scold or rebuke, a synonym for admonish.

clue.text: The fellow coming in top is worth little

indicators.note: the fellow enters the word for top

parts.note: a cap is a top, as on a bottle
he refers to a man

explanation.surface: The man who arrives first turns out to be of little value.
explanation.definitionFit: Something cheap is inexpensive or of poor quality, so it is of little value.

clue.text: Saw commercial taking a long time

parts.note: an ad is an advertisement
an age is a very long period

explanation.surface: Someone watched an advert that seemed to go on forever.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Saw' looks like the past tense of see; it is the noun meaning a saying.
explanation.definitionFit: A saw is an old proverb or maxim, a synonym for an adage.

clue.text: Honesty of Rob overwhelmed by compassion

indicators.note: Rob is engulfed by the compassion word, placed inside it

parts.note: pity is compassion for another

explanation.surface: Rob's honesty is swamped by his kindness.
explanation.definitionFit: Probity is strict integrity and uprightness, a synonym for honesty.

clue.text: Main store could provide this household item

indicators.note: the letters of main store could be worked into something else

explanation.surface: A department store could supply this domestic appliance.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Main store' reads like a big shop; its letters rearrange to give the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: A steam iron is a domestic appliance for pressing clothes, an example of a household item.

clue.text: Music not corrected: get the number wrong

indicators.note: corrected suggests the letters of music not being put into a new order

explanation.surface: Wrong music has been fixed, but someone still lost count.
explanation.definitionFit: To miscount is to tally incorrectly, arriving at a mistaken total.

clue.text: Expert touch

definitions.meaning: a ... hand is a skilled person, an ace

explanation.surface: A specialist's deft contact.
explanation.definitionFit: Dab means both an adept person and a light pat, the two senses read here.

clue.text: Prohibition — one sent to outhouse is ostracised

indicators.note: sent to says the I piece goes before the outbuilding word

parts.note: a ban is a prohibition
I is the Roman numeral one
a shed is a garden outbuilding

explanation.surface: Under a ban, someone is shut out in the shed and shunned.
explanation.definitionFit: Banished means expelled or excluded from a community, as ostracised also does.

clue.text: Juice the old man's knocked over

indicators.note: knocked over turns the letters round, backwards

parts.note: pa's, the old man being a father

explanation.surface: The father's fruit juice has been spilled.
explanation.definitionFit: Sap is the fluid that circulates in plants, a natural juice.

clue.text: Note added on charitable gifts in holy book

indicators.note: the note piece sits on top of the gifts in this down clue

parts.note: PS, a postscript, is a note added to a letter
alms are gifts to the poor

explanation.surface: A note about charitable donations tucked into a Bible.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is the Book of Psalms in the Old Testament.
explanation.definitionFit: The Book of Psalms is one book of the Bible, so it is a holy book.

clue.text: People in government organising means test

indicators.note: organising puts the letters of means test into a new order

explanation.surface: Politicians are arranging a means test for welfare claims.
explanation.walkthrough: A means test checks someone's income before granting state benefit.
explanation.definitionFit: Statesmen are experienced political leaders, people who run a country.

clue.text: Kidnap sailor on vessel

parts.note: AB, able seaman
a duct is a tube or vessel in the body

explanation.surface: A sailor is seized on board ship.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Vessel' suggests a ship but means a tube, as in a blood vessel.
explanation.definitionFit: To abduct someone is to carry them off by force, a synonym for kidnap.

clue.text: Cosmetics put together

definitions.meaning: ..., lipstick and powder applied to the face

explanation.surface: Assembled beauty products.
explanation.definitionFit: The noun names face cosmetics; the phrasal verb means to compose or assemble.

clue.text: Something very hard that's in a suit

definitions.meaning: the gemstone, the hardest natural substance
a card from one of the four suits in a pack

explanation.surface: A tough object found in a set of clothes.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Suit' suggests clothing, but it is a suit of playing cards.
explanation.definitionFit: The gem is the hardest mineral, and the red card suit bears the same name.

clue.text: Descent from treeless upland

definitions.meaning: rolling chalk hills such as the South ... in England

explanation.surface: Coming down off the bare hills.
explanation.walkthrough: The downs are open grassy hills in southern England.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means both a downward slope or fall and an open grassy hill.

clue.text: Dissolute men — they get into scrapes

definitions.meaning: garden tools that scrape the ground

explanation.surface: Debauched men are always in trouble.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Get into scrapes' sounds like the men's trouble but describes garden tools.
explanation.definitionFit: A rake is both a profligate man and a toothed tool dragged to scrape leaves.

clue.text: Sound from pig not good — it being this?

indicators.note: not tells us the letter for good is removed

parts.note: a grunt is a pig's noise

explanation.surface: A pig makes a feeble noise, perhaps because it is the weakling.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition points back to the pig: perhaps its sound is poor because it is the smallest of the litter.
explanation.definitionFit: A runt is the smallest, weakest piglet in a litter, which might explain a poor squeal.

clue.text: Female achieved success, collecting arts degree

indicators.note: the success word gathers the degree inside it

parts.note: won, as in won a contest
MA, Master of Arts

explanation.surface: A female graduate succeeds and picks up her master's.
explanation.definitionFit: A woman is an adult female person, a synonym when the clue word is a noun.

clue.text: Company introducing various menus — what will diners do?

parts.note: CO is the abbreviation for company, and introducing puts it at the front, leading in what follows

indicators.note: various suggests the letters of menus in a different arrangement

explanation.surface: A firm brings in several menus and wonders how customers will respond.
explanation.definitionFit: Diners eat their meals, and to consume is to eat up.
